title: Apply and revert layouts without replacing Content
body:
Integrate reconciliations with the active Project Window manager through deferred mutations: move existing Content, open fresh items for to-open slots, set unused windows aside in Additional windows, never close anything. Implement one-level structural Revert and the event-driven Modified flag.
Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-16-project-layouts-design.md (sections: Applying saved layouts, Filling missing slots, Unused windows, Apply invariants, Revert, Modified paragraph under Save behavior)
Blocked by: cizr5k - Persist project-owned saved layout libraries
Dispatch prerequisite: the spec must be committed and available in the worker checkout. This plan only creates Backlog cards; do not start later waves early.
Done when:
- Apply preserves Session instances/processes, grids/scrollback, Member ids, viewer targets/view state, and title/agent-state ownership. Nothing is ever closed.
- Fresh items open through the Project's existing spawn/open paths before the rearrangement step: default shell in the Project directory, no startup command, no agent. A failed open omits its slot and is reported; it does not abort. Confirm and document the openable kind list.
- Modified is an event flag: structural actions set it, Save/Apply clear it, Revert restores it. Never derived by comparing live state to the definition; resize and an Apply at a different size leave it clear.
- Focus, child zoom, minimized restore, floating bounds, and workspace dirtiness follow the spec. Other Projects and desktop geometry untouched; invalid/stale transitions leave the arrangement intact.
- Revert restores geometry/selection without rewinding Content; Apply-opened items stay open and go to Additional windows; structural edits invalidate it. Never use cold restore for live Apply.
- Prove preservation and A->B->A convergence through manager tests and supported Inspection. Update docs/project-layouts.md.
Gate: Follow AGENTS.md and the build/validation/change-control references. Run cargo check --target-dir target/agent and cargo test --target-dir target/agent, plus focused behavior tests. GUI claims require inspected screenshots; process preservation requires manager/Inspection evidence.
